source: the tier each property is read from when more than one sets it, on a launched process. maxExpectations: system property and environment; maxLogEntries: system property and properties file; maxWebSocketExpectations: properties file and environment; corsMaxAgeInSeconds: all three; maxHeaderSize: environment only; maxSocketTimeout: properties file only; metricsEnabled: system property only; maxFutureTimeout: a blank properties-file value over an environment value; socketConnectionTimeout: a blank system property over an environment value. Everything else is the default.
